subject: GCP Marketplace: SKU capacity wiring & drawdown sprint
messages:
From: Sofie Jacobs <sofie.jacobs@edgewave.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: GCP Marketplace offer: draw schedule & SKU capacity questions

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. We're preparing the internal approvals and procurement packet for the GCP Marketplace private offer and I have a few operational questions that will determine how we phase the commit drawdown. Attaching our usage forecast for Q1 to help with sizing.

High-level asks:
- Can Redwood split the private-offer redemption across two billing profiles (US production vs. EU staging)? Our finance team prefers separate invoices.
- We need a recommended draw schedule: Edgewave is willing to frontload some commitment but would like smoothing options to avoid big invoice spikes.
- How will SKUs map to our existing license ledger? We want clean mapping for amortization and reporting.

Also tagging Marissa on ops details — can you confirm any SKU naming requirements we should expect when we redeem?

Sofie Jacobs
Head of Platform Ops | Edgewave AI
Sofie.Jacobs@edgewave.ai
Attachment: edgewave-usage-forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sofie Jacobs <sofie.jacobs@edgewave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Jan 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace offer: draw schedule & SKU capacity questions

Hi Sofie — thanks for the forecast, that helps a lot. Quick answers and a proposed plan below.

1) Billing profiles: technically we can split redemption across billing profiles but GCP Marketplace treats a private-offer as tied to an Offer ID. In practice we can issue separate invoices if you request two redemption transactions tied to separate billing profiles; timing and ledger mapping change slightly (see note on amortization).

2) Proposed draw schedule (suggested, flexible):
   - Phase A (30%): immediate redemption on signature to cover onboarding and initial throughput testing
   - Phase B (40%): staged monthly draws across months 2–4 to smooth spend
   - Phase C (30%): buffer tranche redeemable later in Q2 based on utilization

This keeps invoice spikes down while ensuring co-sell eligibility is satisfied early. If you prefer frontloading more, we can flip A/B percentages.

3) SKU / ledger mapping: Marissa, can you confirm the exact SKU naming constraints and provide a ledger mapping template we can share with Edgewave? Ben, could you confirm any Marketplace-side constraints (SKU quotas / SKU naming length) that might impact the mapping?

Next steps:
- Marissa to send a mapping CSV and note on invoice timing / amortization.
- I can coordinate with Alex at GCP to confirm co-sell registration and any Marketplace partner-level constraints.
- Sofie: if procurement confirms they want two billing profiles, we’ll prepare two redemption items and a short amendment to the PO.

I’m available for a 30-min sync tomorrow afternoon if that helps to walk through the plan.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of GTM Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofie Jacobs <sofie.jacobs@edgewave.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Alex Huang <alih@google.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Jan 2027 15:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace offer: draw schedule & SKU capacity questions

Hi all — attaching the ledger mapping draft and a short ops note.

Summary / ops constraints:
- SKU mapping: map each billing unit to a single SKU line; avoid compound SKUs across regions. We provide the following template (attached: gcp-offer-ledger-draft.csv).
- Billing profiles: we can support two separate redemption transactions (US / EU) but they will create two OfferRedemption records in GCP. Invoices are generated per redemption and then available for download in the partner console.
- Amortization: recommend monthly straight-line amortization of the redeemed commitment across the quarter to match your revenue recognition needs. If you want to frontload amortization, let us know and we’ll reflect that on the invoice schedule.
- SKU quotas: GCP enforces per-offer SKU quotas; if you expect burst traffic we can reserve capacity on our Dedicated pool but that requires a short-term reservation request (2–4 weeks lead time).

Attachment: gcp-offer-ledger-draft.csv (CSV)
Ops notes: https://redwood.corp/docs/marketplace/redemption-runbook (internal link)

Ben note: please confirm if there are any requested SKU length/character constraints from marketplace engineering.

I can take ownership of generating the two redemption lines once we get confirmation of billing profiles and the PO.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Sofie Jacobs <sofie.jacobs@edgewave.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@edgewave.ai
Date: Sat, 9 Jan 2027 14:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace offer: draw schedule & SKU capacity questions

Thanks Marissa — the mapping CSV looks good and the amortization approach makes sense. Procurement has confirmed they want two billing profiles (US production + EU staging).

Attached is our PO stub (po-edgewave-jan-q1.pdf). Next asks:
- Can you send the two redemption line items and the DocuSign amendment so procurement can review and sign?
- Please confirm final invoice timing (we prefer invoices dated at time-of-redemption but amortized monthly on our side).
- Can Redwood confirm whether reserving dedicated capacity for the initial 2-week onboarding ramp is necessary or recommended? If so, include an estimated reservation fee.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — would like to close signatures by EOD next Tuesday.

Sofie
Sofie Jacobs | Head of Platform Ops, Edgewave AI
Attachment: po-edgewave-jan-q1.pdf (pdf)
